Assistant A provided a more accurate and detailed explanation of the satellite's orbital radius and period of revolution when the speed of the satellite decreases. Assistant A explained that the satellite will move to a lower orbit with a smaller radius, and the period of revolution will decrease as well. Assistant A also addressed edge cases and how to handle them.

On the other hand, Assistant B provided an incorrect response to the initial question, stating that the orbital radius will increase and the period of revolution will decrease. Additionally, Assistant B's response to the second question was repetitive and did not address the edge cases or provide any useful information.

Based on the quality of the responses, [[A]] is the better assistant.
